A frequent question is how UX differs from usability. Usability measures
• New updates
whether tasks can be completed effectively and efficiently. UX is broader,
covering not only task completion but also how people feel throughout the
process. For instance, an app may let users book a flight quickly (usability), but
if the confirmation feels reassuring and the design trustworthy, the overall UX is
stronger.
